game_title: Roll Call Enumerate – Firefly Meadow Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Mystic Forest – Firefly Meadow, a meadow of fireflies: the beast tamer must handle thorn goblins while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Roll Call Enumerate: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call.
theme: Mystic Forest – Firefly Meadow: a meadow of fireflies
core_gameplay_loop: In Firefly Meadow, repeat each round: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the roll_call value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about roll_call to power up the beast tamer and open the elder's door.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 5 (applied tier): Roll Call Enumerate
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how roll_call changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thorn goblins in Firefly Meadow.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 11.
